lessons.titleEn: a lot more is riding on it

target.pattern: \ba lot more (?:is|was|will be) riding on it\b

brief.meaningEn: The outcome of a particular choice now carries substantially greater consequences than before.
brief.meaningZh: 某個決定的結果如今牽涉比以前重要得多的後果。
brief.grammar: a lot more is/was riding on it; it refers to a clear decision or event, and more implies a comparison.
brief.register: Conversational and mildly emphatic. A colleague may say it to a teammate facing a consequential choice.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有明確的決定或事件，以及比先前更大的利害關係；不等於結果必定失敗。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 riding 理解為乘車，也不要只因決定令人緊張便假設後果更大。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項決定、與甚麼情況相比，以及增加的實際後果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 85, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: This choice matters because a lot more is riding on it.
sources.expression: a lot more is riding on it

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 為甚麼這次選供應商比以前更重要？

options.en: The larger order means a poor choice would affect more customers.
options.zh: 訂單較大，若選錯便會影響更多顧客。

options.en: The team has already decided to stop serving customers.
options.zh: 團隊已決定停止服務顧客。

options.en: The order is smaller and less consequential than previous ones.
options.zh: 訂單比以前小，影響也較少。

options.en: The larger order has already guaranteed that the supplier will perform well.
options.zh: 較大的訂單已保證供應商一定做得好。

listening.explanationZh: 訂單擴大，選錯供應商會影響更多顧客，說明這次決定的後果較大。
listening.en: We have chosen suppliers before, but this order serves twice as many customers. A lot more is riding on it this time.
listening.zh: 我們以前也選過供應商，但這次訂單服務的顧客多一倍。這次決定牽涉的後果大得多。

reply.promptEn: Why are you checking the final safety plan more carefully this year?
reply.promptZh: （你今年為何更仔細核對最後的安全計劃？）

options.en: This year more visitors will use the new entrance.
options.zh: 今年會有更多訪客使用新入口。

options.en: A missed detail could affect many more people.
options.zh: 漏掉一項細節可能影響更多人。

options.en: A lot more is riding on it because the event is much larger.
options.zh: 活動規模大得多，因此這次計劃牽涉更重要的後果。

options.en: We want the larger crowd to move through the venue safely.
options.zh: 我們希望較多的人群能安全地進出場地。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能合理解釋加強核對的原因；金句明確表達活動變大帶來更大後果。

scene.promptZh: 過去社團只替十名會員訂午餐；這次要替二百名參加者安排有過敏資訊的餐點。哪句最能說明決定的份量？

options.en: A lot more is riding on it because many more people depend on the order being correct.
options.zh: 這次決定牽涉更大後果，因為更多人依賴訂單準確。

options.en: The order still matters, but its scale and consequences are much like the old one.
options.zh: 訂單仍重要，但規模和後果與以前差不多。

options.en: The main difference is simply that the organiser will place the order later in the day.
options.zh: 主要差別只是主辦者會在較晚的時間落單。

scene.explanationZh: 人數和過敏資料使訂錯餐點的影響較以前大，符合更大利害關係。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不適合說 a lot more is riding on it？

options.en: A small rehearsal becomes a public performance with paid tickets.
options.zh: 小型綵排變成售票公開演出。

options.en: The same weekly meeting repeats with the same people and no new consequences.
options.zh: 同一批人按原樣舉行每週聚會，沒有新增後果。

options.en: A trial timetable becomes the schedule used by every class.
options.zh: 試行時間表成為全校每班使用的正式時間表。

contrast.explanationZh: 單純重複同一聚會，沒有清楚增加的利害關係；另外兩項都有後果擴大。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「去年只做內部示範，明天卻要向所有分店介紹新收銀系統。要不要再測一次？」你怎樣回答較貼切？

options.en: Yes. A lot more is riding on it now, so let us test the checkout steps again.
options.zh: 要。這次牽涉更大後果，我們再測試收銀步驟吧。

options.en: The audience is larger, but we can treat it as exactly the same internal trial.
options.zh: 觀眾雖較多，我們仍可完全當作內部試用。

options.en: We should change the slide colour first and leave the transaction test until after the launch.
options.zh: 我們先改投影片顏色，推出後才測交易流程。

dialogue.explanationZh: 向所有分店介紹比內部示範影響更廣，再測核心流程合乎較大的利害關係。

speaking.en: The scholarship decision affects several students now, so a lot more is riding on it than in last year’s trial.
speaking.zh: 這項獎學金決定如今影響幾名學生，因此比去年試行時牽涉更多後果。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明決定與去年相比有甚麼不同。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：去年社區市集只服務一條街，今年擴展至三個街區。你負責選場地。用一至兩句英文說明為何這次選擇後果較大。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出與去年相比，更多街區的訪客會受場地選擇影響；不要把緊張感當成唯一證據。

examples.en: This year we must choose the venue for the community fair serving three neighbourhoods. A lot more is riding on it than when we served one street.
examples.zh: 今年我們要為服務三個街區的社區市集選場地。與去年只服務一條街相比，這次場地選擇牽涉更多後果。

examples.en: Choosing the venue now matters to three neighbourhoods. A lot more is riding on it than at last year’s small fair: the site must be accessible to visitors from all three.
examples.zh: 現在選場地會影響三個街區。與去年小型市集相比，這次決定牽涉更多後果：場地必須方便三個街區的訪客到達。

takeaways.en: When more people depend on the result, a lot more is riding on it.
takeaways.zh: 更多人依賴結果時，這件事牽涉的後果便更大。

takeaways.en: The device’s public launch is tomorrow; a lot more is riding on it than on last week’s staff rehearsal.
takeaways.zh: 設備明天公開推出；與上星期的員工綵排相比，這次推出牽涉的後果大得多。

brief.meaningEn: A meaningful alternative life path that someone did not choose.
brief.meaningZh: 人生中曾可選擇、最後卻沒有走上的另一條路。
brief.grammar: the road not taken is a noun phrase, often after think about, wonder about or imagine.
brief.register: Reflective literary language. A friend may use it while talking to another adult about an earlier career decision.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有曾可選卻未選的人生方向；思考它不一定代表後悔，亦不是字面上的道路。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把每個未完成的小差事都說成未走的人生路，也不要自行推斷當事人後悔。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出實際選擇和未選方向，並避免把好奇誤作後悔。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 85, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She often thought about the road not taken.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 她想到的 the road not taken 是甚麼？

options.en: The overseas job she did not accept.
options.zh: 她當年沒有接受的海外工作。

options.en: The street she took to her current office.
options.zh: 她前往現時辦公室所走的街道。

options.en: Proof that she regrets her current job every day.
options.zh: 證明她每天都後悔現時工作。

options.en: A plan she already carried out alongside the local job.
options.zh: 她與本地工作同時實行的計劃。

listening.explanationZh: 未接受的海外工作是可選卻未走的人生方向；想到它不必然表示每天後悔。
listening.en: Mina chose a local job ten years ago, although she also had an offer abroad. She sometimes thinks about the road not taken and wonders how life there might have been.
listening.zh: 十年前，美娜選擇了本地工作，雖然她也獲得海外聘用。她有時會想起未走的那條人生路，想像若在當地生活會怎樣。

reply.promptEn: You became a teacher instead of joining the family business. What do you sometimes wonder about?
reply.promptZh: （你選擇當老師，沒有加入家族生意。你有時會想甚麼？）

options.en: I sometimes imagine how working with my family might have changed my days.
options.zh: 我有時想像若與家人共事，日常生活會有甚麼不同。

options.en: I wonder what skills I might have learned in that business.
options.zh: 我會想在那門生意中可能學到甚麼技能。

options.en: I sometimes think about the road not taken: joining the family business.
options.zh: 我有時會想起未走的那條人生路：加入家族生意。

options.en: I am curious how my routine might differ if I had chosen that work.
options.zh: 我好奇若選了那份工作，作息會有甚麼不同。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理描述對未選家族生意的好奇；金句用本課比喻，沒有強加後悔。

scene.promptZh: 一名舞者當年選擇讀法律，沒有接受舞團邀請；多年後，她想像若去巡演人生會如何。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Joining the dance company is the road not taken in her story.
options.zh: 加入舞團是她人生中未走的另一條路。

options.en: Her daily walk to the law office is the road not taken.
options.zh: 她每天步行前往律師樓的路就是那條未走的路。

options.en: Her legal career is the road not taken, although she actually chose it.
options.zh: 法律事業是她未走的路，雖然她實際選了它。

scene.explanationZh: 舞團是她當年可選而未選的重要方向；現職是已選路線，辦公室道路則是字面意思。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合把 the road not taken 當人生比喻？

options.en: An adult wonders what life would be like had she studied medicine instead of design.
options.zh: 一名成年人想像若當年讀醫科而非設計，人生會如何。

options.en: A driver turns left because the road on the right is closed for repairs.
options.zh: 司機因右邊道路封閉維修而轉左。

options.en: A parent thinks about a university offer declined years ago.
options.zh: 一位家長回想多年前拒絕的大學取錄。

contrast.explanationZh: 封路轉彎只屬字面交通選擇；另外兩項涉及未選的重要人生方向。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我選了社工，沒有開咖啡店；有時會想另一種生活。」你怎樣回應才不會自行推斷她後悔？

options.en: That café is the road not taken for you; wondering about it does not mean you regret social work.
options.zh: 開咖啡店是你未走的那條路；想到它不代表你後悔當社工。

options.en: Thinking about a café proves you chose the wrong career.
options.zh: 想到咖啡店就證明你選錯職業。

options.en: You should stop mentioning the café because it never became your job.
options.zh: 咖啡店最後沒有成為你的工作，所以你不應再提。

dialogue.explanationZh: 想像未選方向可以只是反思或好奇，不能當作後悔的證據。

speaking.en: He stayed in his hometown to teach, but he occasionally wonders about the road not taken: studying abroad.
speaking.zh: 他留在家鄉任教，但偶爾會想像未走的那條路：到海外升學。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出他實際選了甚麼、沒有選甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：莎拉當年選擇經營家族店舖，沒有接受博物館見習機會。她如今對另一種生活感到好奇，但沒有說自己後悔。用一至兩句英文描述這條未選的路。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出已選的家族店舖和未選的博物館見習，保留好奇與後悔之間的區別。

examples.en: Sara chose to run the family shop, but she sometimes wonders about the road not taken: the museum traineeship she declined.
examples.zh: 莎拉選擇經營家族店舖，但有時會想像未走的那條路：她當年拒絕的博物館見習機會。

examples.en: The museum traineeship is the road not taken for Sara; she is curious about it without saying she regrets running the shop.
examples.zh: 對莎拉而言，博物館見習機會是未走的那條路；她對此好奇，卻沒有說自己後悔經營店舖。

takeaways.en: The road not taken can be worth imagining without making the chosen life a mistake.
takeaways.zh: 想像未走的那條路，不等於認定已選人生是錯誤。

takeaways.en: She thinks about the road not taken when she remembers the offer she declined.
takeaways.zh: 她回想當年拒絕的機會時，會想到未走的那條路。

brief.meaningEn: Think of or create an idea, answer or workable solution.
brief.meaningZh: 想出一個主意、答案或可行方案。
brief.grammar: come/came/coming up with + an idea, answer or solution; the object follows with.
brief.register: Neutral everyday teamwork language. A teacher may ask a group how they arrived at a practical idea.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課着重產生主意，不等於已完成實行；come up with money 是另一用法，不在本課範圍。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把提出想法誤說成已驗證有效，也不要把 up 理解為物件向上移動。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明誰想出甚麼主意，並區分提出、測試和實行。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 88, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The class will come up with ways to save energy.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

options.en: It generated a new way to reduce paper use.
options.zh: 小組想出了一個減少用紙的新方法。

options.en: It confirmed that the idea had already saved paper.
options.zh: 小組證實這個主意已經節省了紙張。

options.en: It copied an existing rule without discussing alternatives.
options.zh: 小組沒有討論其他選擇，只照搬現有規則。

options.en: It raised money to purchase more paper.
options.zh: 小組籌款購買更多紙張。

listening.explanationZh: 成員討論後想出雙面列印試行方案；錄音尚未說已測試成功。
listening.en: After comparing three suggestions, the class came up with a plan to trial double-sided printing. They have not tested it yet.
listening.zh: 全班比較三個建議後，想出試行雙面列印的計劃。他們尚未測試。

reply.promptEn: How did your group get a slogan for the community poster?
reply.promptZh: （你們小組怎樣為社區海報想出標語？）

options.en: We brainstormed several short lines together.
options.zh: 我們一起集思廣益，想了幾句簡短標語。

options.en: A classmate suggested one during the meeting.
options.zh: 一名同學在會議上提出了一句。

options.en: We came up with a line after discussing the main message.
options.zh: 我們討論主要訊息後，想出一句標語。

options.en: We compared ideas and chose the clearest one.
options.zh: 我們比較了各個主意，選出最清楚的一句。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理交代標語如何產生；金句明確用 come up with 指想出內容。

scene.promptZh: 社區中心想讓輪椅使用者更容易到課室。義工討論後提出在入口增設清楚指示牌的新方案，但尚未施工。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The volunteers came up with a signposting idea to make the route clearer.
options.zh: 義工想出增設指示牌的主意，使路線更清楚。

options.en: The volunteers completed the new entrance signs before their first discussion.
options.zh: 義工第一次討論前已完成新入口指示牌。

options.en: The volunteers only measured the existing signs and proposed no change.
options.zh: 義工只量度現有指示牌，沒有提出改動。

scene.explanationZh: 討論後提出新方案是想出主意，並不表示已施工。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 come up with 表示「想出方案」？

options.en: A cook devises a new menu after asking customers what they need.
options.zh: 廚師詢問顧客需要後，想出新餐單。

options.en: A club collects the membership fees it was already owed, without proposing any idea.
options.zh: 社團收回本來應收的會費，沒有提出任何主意。

options.en: Students suggest a safer walking route after studying a map.
options.zh: 學生研究地圖後，提出較安全的步行路線。

contrast.explanationZh: 收會費並沒有產生主意；本課 come up with 不是籌集或取得金錢的用法。

dialogue.promptZh: 隊友說：「我們知道雨天會令義賣攤位受影響，但還沒有解決方法。」你會怎樣接話？

options.en: Let us come up with a backup layout under the covered walkway, then check if it is permitted.
options.zh: 我們想出在有蓋走廊擺檔的後備安排，再核實是否獲准。

options.en: We have already solved the problem merely by naming the risk.
options.zh: 我們指出風險，就等於已解決問題。

options.en: We should order new signs before deciding where the stalls could go.
options.zh: 我們未決定攤位可放在哪裏，就先訂新指示牌。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先想出後備安排，再查是否可行，對應目前欠缺方案的需要。

speaking.en: The volunteers came up with a new timetable, but they still need to ask the families whether it works.
speaking.zh: 義工想出一份新時間表，但仍須詢問家庭是否可行。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再區分提出新想法與確認它可行。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：體育館訪客經常找不到回收桶。學生團隊要提出位置指示方案，但尚未測試。用一至兩句英文說明他們想出甚麼，以及下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出具體的新指示方案，並把「想出」與其後審視或測試分開。

examples.en: We came up with a plan to place clearly marked recycling bins near the sports hall, then asked the caretaker to review it.
examples.zh: 我們想出在體育館附近放置清晰標示回收桶的計劃，然後請管理員審視。

examples.en: The student team came up with a simple bin map for the sports hall; they will test whether visitors can follow it.
examples.zh: 學生團隊為體育館想出一張簡單回收桶位置圖；他們會測試訪客是否看得懂。

glossary.en: test whether visitors can follow it

takeaways.en: A team can come up with a promising idea before it knows whether the idea will work.
takeaways.zh: 團隊可以先想出有希望的主意，再查證它是否可行。

takeaways.en: She came up with a clearer sign after asking visitors where they got lost.
takeaways.zh: 她詢問訪客在哪裏迷路後，想出更清楚的指示牌。

brief.meaningEn: Extend what people can understand in a field by gaining well-supported new insight.
brief.meaningZh: 透過有根據的新發現，拓展人們在某個領域可理解的範圍。
brief.grammar: push/pushed/pushing the boundaries of understanding; say what field or question is advanced.
brief.register: Elevated but natural in research or educational discussion. A researcher may explain it to students when new evidence changes a field.
brief.boundaryZh: 要帶來超越現有認識的可靠新理解；只重複舊知識或提出未驗證猜測，不等於拓展界限。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是字面推動邊界，也不表示每項新資料都構成重大突破。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨有證據的新理解與單純重複或猜測。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 88, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: New methods can push the boundaries of understanding.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 新記錄可能帶來甚麼學術價值？

options.en: They may show a previously unknown migration pattern.
options.zh: 它們可能顯示過去未知的遷移模式。

options.en: They prove every earlier map was deliberately false.
options.zh: 它們證明所有舊地圖都是刻意造假。

options.en: They are useful only because the paper is old.
options.zh: 它們的價值只在紙張古老。

options.en: They remove any need to compare the records with other evidence.
options.zh: 它們令研究者毋須再與其他證據比較。

listening.explanationZh: 把新航海記錄與舊地圖比較，可能揭示之前未知的模式；仍須核實，不能作絕對斷言。
listening.en: Researchers found shipping records that may reveal an unknown migration pattern. By checking them against older maps, they could push the boundaries of understanding.
listening.zh: 研究者找到可能揭示未知遷移模式的航運記錄。若與舊地圖核對，它們或能拓展人們對本地歷史的理解。

reply.promptEn: How could the new ocean survey help researchers?
reply.promptZh: （新的海洋調查可以怎樣幫助研究者？）

options.en: It may reveal movements that earlier instruments could not detect.
options.zh: 它可能顯示舊儀器無法探測的動向。

options.en: It may give researchers evidence to revise an old explanation.
options.zh: 它可能提供證據，讓研究者修訂舊解釋。

options.en: Careful analysis of this habitat could push the boundaries of understanding.
options.zh: 仔細分析或能拓展我們對這片棲息地的理解。

options.en: It may help scientists ask more precise questions about the habitat.
options.zh: 它可能幫科學家就棲息地提出更精確的問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出調查可能帶來的新理解或更精確問題；金句指出有根據的分析可拓展認識。

scene.promptZh: 研究小組把多年未整理的天氣記錄與新測量結果核對，發現山谷有以前未被記錄的微氣候，並讓別組重做分析。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Their verified finding could push the boundaries of understanding in local climate research.
options.zh: 這項經核實的發現，或能拓展本地氣候研究的理解界限。

options.en: The group merely recopied the old records without identifying anything new.
options.zh: 小組只抄錄舊記錄，沒有找出新發現。

options.en: The finding is already certain although no comparison or repeat check took place.
options.zh: 雖然沒有比較或重複檢查，發現已完全確定。

scene.explanationZh: 新測量與舊記錄核對後發現未知現象，並供別組複查，才有機會拓展理解。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最不足以支持 push the boundaries of understanding？

options.en: A team tests a new explanation against several independent observations.
options.zh: 團隊用幾組獨立觀察驗證新解釋。

options.en: A class copies a known definition into a notebook without adding evidence or a new explanation.
options.zh: 全班把已知定義抄進筆記，沒有新增證據或解釋。

options.en: Researchers compare new records with old ones and discover a pattern that needs further checking.
options.zh: 研究者比較新舊記錄，發現一個仍需複查的模式。

contrast.explanationZh: 抄寫已知定義可幫助學習，卻未拓展知識界限；其他做法有新理解的可能。

dialogue.promptZh: 學生說：「我看到一張令人意外的圖，就能宣布自己改寫了整個領域吧？」老師怎樣回應最合宜？

options.en: The graph may help push the boundaries of understanding, but we need to check the data and compare other studies first.
options.zh: 這張圖或有助拓展理解，但我們須先核對數據，並比較其他研究。

options.en: An unexpected graph is enough to declare every earlier result wrong.
options.zh: 一張意外的圖已足以宣布所有舊結果都錯。

options.en: Because the graph is surprising, we should avoid asking what it means.
options.zh: 因為圖表令人意外，我們不應再問它代表甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認新圖可能有價值，同時要求核對及比較，避免把未驗證資料當成突破。

speaking.en: New evidence about the river could push the boundaries of understanding, provided other teams can confirm the pattern.
speaking.zh: 關於河流的新證據若獲其他團隊確認，或能拓展我們的理解。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明新理解為何仍需要核實。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：博物館找到描述一條被遺忘貿易路線的舊信件。研究者計劃與地圖核對，才判斷是否有新認識。用一至兩句英文描述可能的意義與核實步驟。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出具體可能新增的理解，以及信件與地圖核對的重要性；不要直接宣稱已證實。

examples.en: The museum found letters describing a forgotten trade route; careful comparison with maps could push the boundaries of understanding in local trade history.
examples.zh: 博物館找到描述一條被遺忘貿易路線的信件；仔細與地圖比較，或能拓展人們對本地貿易史的理解。

examples.en: If researchers verify the old letters against maps, the discovery of a forgotten trade route may push the boundaries of understanding in local trade history.
examples.zh: 若研究者把舊信件與地圖核對，發現一條被遺忘的貿易路線，或能拓展人們對本地貿易史的理解。

glossary.en: letters describing a forgotten trade route
glossary.zh: 描述被遺忘貿易路線的信件

glossary.en: verify the old letters against maps

takeaways.en: Mapping a newly found cave may push the boundaries of understanding in geology without answering every question.
takeaways.zh: 繪製一個新發現洞穴的地圖，或能拓展地質學的理解界限，但未必能回答所有問題。

takeaways.en: A surprising claim will not push the boundaries of understanding until researchers test it.
takeaways.zh: 令人意外的說法要經研究者驗證，才可能拓展理解界限。

brief.meaningEn: Prevent an existing feeling, tendency or force from becoming excessive while allowing a useful amount.
brief.meaningZh: 防止已有的情緒、傾向或力量變得過度，同時容許適度存在。
brief.grammar: keep/kept/keeping + it + in check; it needs a clear antecedent such as enthusiasm, spending or competition.
brief.register: Neutral practical advice. A friend may say it to another friend discussing an enjoyable habit that needs limits.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是有節制，不是完全壓制；須說清楚 it 指甚麼，以及用甚麼界線控制。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要讓 it 無指涉對象，也不要把 check 誤解為單純「檢查資料」。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出需要限制的傾向及保留合理程度的方法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 88, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Curiosity matters, but evidence must keep it in check.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

options.en: It limits the team’s enthusiasm so they can still rest.
options.zh: 它限制團隊熱情的程度，讓大家仍可休息。

options.en: It proves that the team has stopped enjoying the project.
options.zh: 它證明團隊已不再喜歡這項計劃。

options.en: It checks whether everyone has signed the attendance sheet.
options.zh: 它只核對大家是否簽了出席表。

options.en: It encourages the team to work every night without a break.
options.zh: 它鼓勵團隊每晚不停工作。

listening.explanationZh: 團隊仍喜歡計劃，但時間表防止熱情導致每晚過勞。
listening.en: The team is excited about the project, but that enthusiasm is leading to late work every night. A weekly schedule helps keep it in check without ending the project.
listening.zh: 團隊對計劃很有熱情，但這份熱情令大家每晚工作到很晚。每週時間表有助加以節制，而不用結束計劃。

reply.promptEn: How do you enjoy buying books online without spending beyond your budget?
reply.promptZh: （你怎樣享受網上買書，同時不超出預算？）

options.en: I set a monthly amount before browsing.
options.zh: 我在瀏覽前先定每月可花的金額。

options.en: I wait a day before placing an order.
options.zh: 我下單前會等一天。

options.en: I keep it in check by using a book budget.
options.zh: 我用購書預算控制花費。

options.en: I borrow some books instead of buying every title.
options.zh: 有些書我會借來看，而非每本都買。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都能說明控制購書開支的方法；金句的 it 指前述花費。

scene.promptZh: 學生很喜歡練琴，但連續兩週練到深夜，影響睡眠。他訂了晚上九時停練的規則，仍每天練習。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The student keeps it in check with a stopping time while continuing to practise.
options.zh: 學生仍繼續練琴，但用停練時間加以節制。

options.en: The student has abandoned music entirely to avoid late nights.
options.zh: 學生完全放棄音樂，以免夜睡。

options.en: The student has added another late-night session to make practice even longer.
options.zh: 學生加了一節深夜練習，令時間更長。

scene.explanationZh: 停練時間限制過量練習，同時保留有益的日常練習；it 指前述練琴熱情。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個做法最不符合 keep it in check 的「節制但不消除」意思？

options.en: A runner sets a rest day while keeping up regular exercise.
options.zh: 跑手安排休息日，同時保持定期運動。

options.en: A club ends all discussion because one meeting ran long.
options.zh: 社團因一次會議超時便完全停止討論。

options.en: A gamer uses a timer to leave enough time for homework.
options.zh: 玩家用計時器，留下足夠時間做功課。

contrast.explanationZh: 完全停止討論是消除活動，而非將其控制在合理程度。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「大家很想分享意見，但每次會議都越開越長。」你怎樣回應較有建設性？

options.en: That enthusiasm is useful; let us keep it in check with a clear agenda and a finish time.
options.zh: 這份熱情有用；我們用清楚議程和結束時間加以節制。

options.en: Because meetings run long, nobody should share any ideas from now on.
options.zh: 會議超時，所以以後誰都不應分享意見。

options.en: The energy is positive, so we should remove the finish time and let every meeting expand.
options.zh: 大家有熱情，所以應取消結束時間，任由會議延長。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留參與熱情，同時用議程和時限防止過度，才符合節制的意思。

speaking.en: Competition can motivate the players, but the coach must keep it in check so they still support one another.
speaking.zh: 競爭可以激勵球員，但教練必須加以節制，讓他們仍互相支持。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明如何保留競爭的好處而避免過度。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：瑪雅喜歡看短片，但最近每晚看得太久，影響功課。她想保留適量觀看時間，並設定半小時計時器。用一至兩句英文描述怎樣節制。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說清楚 it 指看短片的習慣、半小時計時器的作用，以及她沒有完全停止觀看。

examples.en: Maya enjoys watching short videos, but she keeps it in check with a half-hour timer before doing her homework.
examples.zh: 瑪雅喜歡看短片，但她在做功課前設半小時計時器加以節制。

examples.en: Maya enjoys watching short videos, and a half-hour timer helps her keep it in check: she can still watch videos without letting them take over her evening.
examples.zh: 瑪雅喜歡看短片，半小時計時器幫她節制觀看時間：她仍可觀看，但不會讓短片佔據整個晚上。

takeaways.en: Book buying can be enjoyable, and a clear budget can keep it in check.
takeaways.zh: 買書可以是樂趣，而清楚的預算有助節制開支。

takeaways.en: Their enthusiasm was strong, but the team kept it in check with a finish time.
takeaways.zh: 團隊熱情很高，但設定結束時間可防止會議過長。

brief.meaningEn: A belief or forecast supported mainly by what someone wants, despite weak or contrary evidence.
brief.meaningZh: 主要因自己希望某事成真而相信，卻缺乏足夠證據，甚至與證據相反。
brief.grammar: wishful thinking is an uncountable noun phrase; describe a claim as wishful thinking or say it would be wishful thinking to expect something.
brief.register: Neutral to mildly critical. A colleague may say it to a project team checking an optimistic forecast.
brief.boundaryZh: 願望本身不是錯；問題是把願望當成已獲支持的預測。若有可靠證據，就不宜只稱之為一廂情願。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把每個樂觀目標都當作 wishful thinking；先問有沒有數據或合理根據。
brief.outcomeZh: 能辨別希望、證據和沒有充分根據的預測。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 88, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The forecast was wishful thinking without data.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 為甚麼說下週一定好天氣是一廂情願？

options.en: The forecast points to rain, but the organisers assume sunshine because they want it.
options.zh: 預報有雨，主辦者卻因希望晴天而假設會放晴。

options.en: Several reliable forecasts now agree that the weather will be sunny.
options.zh: 幾個可靠預報都同意會放晴。

options.en: The organisers decided to prepare a rain plan as well.
options.zh: 主辦者也決定準備雨天方案。

options.en: The event was moved to an indoor venue.
options.zh: 活動已改在室內舉行。

listening.explanationZh: 雨天預報與「一定晴天」的說法相反；想要好天氣不能代替證據。
listening.en: The forecast shows rain all week, but the organisers insist the outdoor fair will have perfect sunshine because they want it to. That is wishful thinking.
listening.zh: 預報顯示整週有雨，但主辦者因希望晴天，堅持戶外市集一定陽光普照。這是一廂情願的想法。

reply.promptEn: Why will you not promise that the new café will make a profit immediately?
reply.promptZh: （你為何不保證新咖啡店會立即賺錢？）

options.en: We have not yet checked enough local demand.
options.zh: 我們尚未充分調查本地需求。

options.en: Costs may be higher than our first estimate.
options.zh: 成本可能高於最初估計。

options.en: Without sales evidence, that promise would be wishful thinking.
options.zh: 沒有銷售證據就作這種保證，只是一廂情願。

options.en: We need realistic figures before making a firm forecast.
options.zh: 我們需要實際數字，才可作確定預測。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理解釋為何暫不保證盈利；金句指出願望不能代替銷售證據。

scene.promptZh: 社團上次活動有四十人參加，這次宣傳尚未開始，主席卻因「很想爆滿」便宣稱明天一定有四百人。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The claim of four hundred attendees is wishful thinking without new evidence.
options.zh: 沒有新證據就宣稱有四百人參加，是一廂情願。

options.en: The claim is supported by confirmed bookings from four hundred people.
options.zh: 四百人已確定報名，所以說法有根據。

options.en: The chair hopes for more people but says the final number is still unknown.
options.zh: 主席希望人數增加，但承認最終人數尚未知道。

scene.explanationZh: 主席把願望當作確定預測，沒有新增報名證據；單純希望更多人不等於一廂情願的斷言。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合稱為 wishful thinking？

options.en: A team predicts doubled sales solely because its members feel optimistic.
options.zh: 團隊只因成員樂觀，就預測銷售翻倍。

options.en: A shop forecasts modest growth using several months of confirmed orders and clear assumptions.
options.zh: 店舖根據數月已確認訂單及清楚假設，預測小幅增長。

options.en: A student assumes a difficult test was passed without checking any answers.
options.zh: 學生沒有核對答案，就認定自己通過難考試。

contrast.explanationZh: 訂單和假設為小幅增長提供根據，不能只因預測樂觀就稱之為一廂情願。

dialogue.promptZh: 隊友說：「我希望我們的節目一推出就吸引十萬人；所以預算直接按十萬觀眾來做吧。」你怎樣回應較審慎？

options.en: That number may be wishful thinking without audience data; let us model a few realistic cases.
options.zh: 沒有觀眾數據，這個數字可能只是一廂情願；我們先估算幾種實際情況。

options.en: Wanting a large audience proves it will happen, so one estimate is enough.
options.zh: 希望有大量觀眾就證明會成真，所以只要一個估算。

options.en: Because the figure is uncertain, we should abandon every effort to estimate an audience.
options.zh: 數字不確定，所以我們應完全放棄估算觀眾。

dialogue.explanationZh: 回應分清目標與證據，並提出較穩健的估算方法。

speaking.en: I hope the show succeeds, but predicting a full house without ticket data would be wishful thinking.
speaking.zh: 我希望演出成功，但沒有售票數據就預測滿座，會是一廂情願。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分辨希望演出成功與保證滿座。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：慈善音樂會希望滿座，但主辦者尚未查看訂票資料，就想宣布已售罄。用一至兩句英文指出願望和證據的分別，並提出下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出滿座是願望，售罄宣稱尚無訂票數據支持，並提出核對數字。

examples.en: The charity wants to fill every seat, but claiming the concert is already sold out without booking data would be wishful thinking.
examples.zh: 慈善機構希望座位全滿，但沒有訂票數據就宣稱音樂會已售罄，只是一廂情願。

examples.en: It would be wishful thinking to promise a sell-out before anyone has checked the bookings; the charity should review the figures first.
examples.zh: 未核對訂票情況便保證售罄，會是一廂情願；慈善機構應先查看數字。

takeaways.en: A hopeful forecast becomes wishful thinking when it ignores clear evidence.
takeaways.zh: 樂觀預測若無視明確證據，就會變成一廂情願。

takeaways.en: Checking the bookings can keep a sales target from becoming wishful thinking.
takeaways.zh: 核對訂票情況，有助避免把銷售目標當成毫無根據的預測。

lessons.titleEn: cling to it for dear life

brief.meaningEn: Hold on to an idea or plan with excessive determination even when circumstances or evidence call for change.
brief.meaningZh: 即使情況或證據要求改變，仍過度執着於原有想法或計劃。
brief.grammar: cling/clung/clinging to it for dear life; it refers to a stated idea, plan or belief. For dear life intensifies the figurative grip.
brief.register: Vivid informal criticism. A teammate may say it to another teammate who resists revising a failing plan.
brief.boundaryZh: 本課着重在有充分理由修改時仍死守；有根據地堅持原則，不一定是不合理執着。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 for dear life 當作真的面對死亡，也不要把所有持續努力都視為固執。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原有想法、反對它的新證據，以及應否修訂。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 88, row 14; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Do not cling to it for dear life when the evidence changes.
sources.expression: cling to it for dear life

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

listening.promptZh: 說話者為何批評負責人的做法？

options.en: She kept the old schedule despite evidence that it was no longer working.
options.zh: 她明知舊時間表不再有效，仍堅持沿用。

options.en: She revised the schedule after examining the new figures.
options.zh: 她查看新數字後修訂了時間表。

options.en: She kept the old timetable only while testing a possible replacement.
options.zh: 她只在測試替代安排期間暫用舊時間表。

options.en: She had no new evidence about the timetable at all.
options.zh: 她完全沒有關於時間表的新證據。

listening.explanationZh: 新出席數字顯示時段不合適，她卻死守舊安排；此處是對計劃的比喻性執着。
listening.en: New attendance figures showed that the old class timetable no longer worked, but the organiser clung to it for dear life and refused to adjust a single session.
listening.zh: 新出席數字顯示舊課堂時間表已不合適，但主辦者仍死守不放，拒絕調整任何一節課。

reply.promptEn: Why are you revising the first travel route after the road closure?
reply.promptZh: （道路封閉後，你為何修訂原定行程路線？）

options.en: The original route no longer reaches the venue directly.
options.zh: 原來的路線不再能直接到達場地。

options.en: The closure gives us a reason to check another route.
options.zh: 封路讓我們有理由考慮另一條路線。

options.en: I do not want to cling to it for dear life when the road is closed.
options.zh: 既然道路封閉，我不想仍死守原來的路線。

options.en: A revised route could save everyone time.
options.zh: 修訂路線可能節省大家的時間。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理解釋修訂原定路線的原因；金句表達不會無視新情況而死守。

scene.promptZh: 編輯起初主張印一千份手冊，但報名人數只剩一百。財務同事提出數據後，他仍拒絕改印量，只說「原計劃不能動」。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The editor is clinging to it for dear life despite the new registration numbers.
options.zh: 報名數字已改變，編輯仍死守原計劃不放。

options.en: The editor is adjusting the print run to match actual demand.
options.zh: 編輯正按實際需求調整印量。

options.en: The editor has checked both options and has good evidence that all copies are needed.
options.zh: 編輯已核對兩個方案，並有充分證據顯示所有手冊都用得上。

scene.explanationZh: 新的報名數字已削弱原計劃的依據，他卻拒絕修訂，符合過度執着的意思。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 cling to it for dear life？

options.en: A manager ignores three failed trials and insists on the same process.
options.zh: 經理無視三次失敗試行，仍堅持同一流程。

options.en: A team keeps a plan after fresh testing confirms it still works well.
options.zh: 團隊經新測試確認計劃仍有效，因此繼續採用。

options.en: A student refuses to correct a draft after receiving clear factual evidence.
options.zh: 學生收到清楚事實證據後，仍拒絕更正初稿。

contrast.explanationZh: 經新測試確認有效後繼續採用，是有根據的堅持；另兩項無視修訂理由。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們已設計好戶外電影夜，就算天文台宣布暴雨，我也不肯改室內。」你怎樣回應才有建設性？

options.en: I know we worked hard on it, but the forecast makes an indoor plan safer; we should not cling to it for dear life.
options.zh: 我知道大家下了功夫，但預報顯示應改為較安全的室內方案時，我們不應死守原計劃。

options.en: Because we worked hard, the forecast cannot affect the outdoor event.
options.zh: 因為大家下了功夫，預報就不可能影響戶外活動。

options.en: Let us cancel the film entirely without considering an indoor option.
options.zh: 我們不用考慮室內選擇，直接取消電影放映吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認投入，同時根據暴雨預報提出安全調整，比死守或直接放棄更貼切。

speaking.en: The first survey idea was useful, but we should not cling to it for dear life after the pilot shows a clearer method.
speaking.zh: 首個調查構想本來有用，但試行顯示有更清楚的方法後，我們不應再死守不放。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明何時應修訂原有想法。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區花園原計劃種向日葵，新的遮蔭測試卻顯示場地陽光不足。有人提出改種適合陰處的蕨類。用一至兩句英文說明為何不應死守原計劃。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出原計劃、遮蔭證據，以及改種蕨類的合理方向；不要把修訂說成完全放棄花園。

examples.en: The garden group had a plan to grow sunflowers, but the shade tests showed too little sunlight; we should not cling to it for dear life and could plant ferns instead.
examples.zh: 花園小組原有種植向日葵的計劃，但遮蔭測試顯示陽光不足；我們不應死守這項計劃，可以改種蕨類。

examples.en: The sunflower plan was attractive, yet the new shade readings challenge it. We need not cling to it for dear life when ferns would suit the site better.
examples.zh: 向日葵計劃很吸引，但新的遮蔭數據削弱了它。我們毋須死守，因為蕨類更適合這個地點。

takeaways.en: An old plan may be valuable; when facts change, we need not cling to it for dear life.
takeaways.zh: 舊計劃可以有價值，但事實改變時，我們毋須死守。

takeaways.en: She clung to it for dear life even after the trial showed the design would fail.
takeaways.zh: 試行已顯示設計會失敗，她仍死守不放。

brief.meaningEn: Fail to attract attention or leave a noticeable lasting effect, despite being released or presented.
brief.meaningZh: 事情已推出或提出，卻幾乎無人注意，也沒有留下明顯影響。
brief.grammar: sink/sank/sunk/sinking without a trace; often used of a message, campaign, product or idea.
brief.register: Vivid neutral-to-informal commentary. A communications organiser may say it to a teammate reviewing why an announcement failed to reach people.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是推出後沒有引起注意或持續影響；不要求數碼檔案真的消失，也不是只指尚未發布。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把它只當船隻下沉；有少量回應也不必然等於完全沒有影響。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分已推出卻未被注意、尚未推出，以及引起持續回應。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 89, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A weak message can sink without a trace.

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent reviews remain pending.

options.en: It received almost no response and was soon forgotten.
options.zh: 它幾乎沒有回應，很快被遺忘。

options.en: It inspired a large group of volunteers over several weeks.
options.zh: 它在數週內激勵大量義工。

options.en: It was drafted but never published.
options.zh: 它只起草了，從未發布。

options.en: The group used the replies to plan a second appeal.
options.zh: 小組根據回覆籌劃第二次呼籲。

listening.explanationZh: 呼籲已發布卻沒有回覆，之後也沒人提起；這裏說的是缺乏影響，而非檔案消失。
listening.en: The appeal went online last month, but nobody replied and the group never mentioned it again. It sank without a trace.
listening.zh: 呼籲上月已上網，但沒有人回覆，小組其後也沒有再提。它無聲無息地被忽略了。

reply.promptEn: What happened to your first neighbourhood appeal after you posted it?
reply.promptZh: （你第一次發布的社區呼籲後來怎樣了？）

options.en: It drew no replies and was soon forgotten.
options.zh: 它沒有收到回覆，很快被遺忘。

options.en: Hardly anyone noticed it after publication.
options.zh: 發布後幾乎沒有人注意。

options.en: It sank without a trace; we will rewrite it before trying again.
options.zh: 它發布後無人留意；我們會重寫再試。

options.en: It did not lead to the volunteers we hoped for.
options.zh: 它沒有招來我們希望找到的義工。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都合理描述已發布呼籲沒有引起反應；金句用沉沒比喻。

scene.promptZh: 學生報把一篇訪問放上網站，但只出現在不易找到的舊頁面；一個月來幾乎沒人點閱，也沒人討論。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The interview sank without a trace after it was posted.
options.zh: 訪問刊出後無人留意，幾乎沒有留下影響。

options.en: The interview became a lasting topic of school discussion.
options.zh: 訪問成了校內長期討論話題。

options.en: The interview is still being edited and has not appeared online.
options.zh: 訪問仍在編輯，尚未上網。

scene.explanationZh: 訪問已推出，卻幾乎沒有讀者或討論，符合推出後無聲無息的意思。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說 sink without a trace？

options.en: A new leaflet is distributed, but nobody keeps or mentions it.
options.zh: 新單張已派發，但沒有人保留或提起。

options.en: A small video keeps attracting questions and is shared for months.
options.zh: 短片持續引來提問，並在數月間被分享。

options.en: A campaign message appears once and draws no response.
options.zh: 宣傳訊息只出現一次，沒有收到回應。

contrast.explanationZh: 短片持續引發分享和提問，已有可見影響；另兩項推出後幾乎無聲無息。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「我們已寫好重要的防暑提示，但只打算在很少人看的內頁放一次。」你怎樣回應較有幫助？

options.en: It could sink without a trace there; let us share the advice where residents actually look.
options.zh: 放在那裏可能無人留意；我們把提示發到居民真正會看的地方吧。

options.en: If the advice is important, one hidden posting will certainly reach everyone.
options.zh: 提示重要，放在隱蔽位置一次也一定人人看到。

options.en: We should wait for the page to be deleted before telling residents anything.
options.zh: 我們應等網頁被刪除，才告知居民。

dialogue.explanationZh: 考慮受眾會否看到訊息，能防止提示推出後毫無反應；其餘回應無視傳播方式。

speaking.en: The concert notice sank without a trace online, so the organisers shared a clearer version through local groups.
speaking.zh: 音樂會通告在網上幾乎無人注意，主辦者於是透過本地群組發布較清楚的版本。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出原通告的結果和補救方法。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你的樂隊上載新曲時沒有標題或介紹，也沒有分享連結，幾乎沒有人播放。用一至兩句英文說明已推出的歌曲為何無人注意，以及下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出歌曲已上載、缺少易搜尋的資料或分享，以致幾乎無人注意，並提出具體改善。

examples.en: Our band uploaded a new track without a title or description, and it sank without a trace; we later added clear details and shared it with listeners.
examples.zh: 我們的樂隊上載新曲時沒有標題或介紹，結果幾乎無人注意；之後我們補上清楚資料，並分享給聽眾。

examples.en: The track sank without a trace when listeners could not find it, so the band will add a searchable title and share the link.
examples.zh: 聽眾找不到這首歌，它上載後便無聲無息地被忽略；所以樂隊會加上可搜尋的標題並分享連結。

takeaways.en: A good idea may sink without a trace if the intended audience never sees it.
takeaways.zh: 好主意若沒有被目標受眾看見，也可能無聲無息地被忽略。

takeaways.en: The first appeal sank without a trace, so the team changed how it reached people.
takeaways.zh: 首次呼籲幾乎沒有留下影響，因此團隊改變了接觸大眾的方法。
